description: This file defines the TechDataServices class which provides a suite of services related to manufacturing technical data within the OFBIZ framework. The services include retrieving routing tasks, checking associations, accessing calendar data, and computing capacity and date adjustments related to production scheduling.

classes.name: TechDataServices
classes.description: A utility class providing manufacturing technical data services such as retrieving routing tasks, validating routing associations, and performing calendar and capacity calculations.

methods.name: lookupRoutingTask
methods.description: Retrieves routing tasks based on optional name and machine group filters, returning active routing tasks of type ROU_TASK.

methods.name: checkRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Checks for conflicts or overlaps in routing task associations based on sequence number and date ranges.

methods.name: getTechDataCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves the associated TechDataCalendar for a given routing task, defaulting if no specific calendar is found.

methods.name: dayStartCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the first day starting from a given date where capacity is available in the TechDataCalendarWeek, considering exceptions.

methods.name: capacityRemaining
methods.description: Calculates the remaining capacity available in a calendar for a specified date.

methods.name: startNextDay
methods.description: Advances to the next available day in the calendar to begin capacity allocation.

methods.name: addForward
methods.description: Moves forward in time from a starting date by a specified duration, respecting calendar availability.

methods.name: dayEndCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the last day in the week where capacity is still available, moving backwards from a given day.

methods.name: capacityRemainingBackward
methods.description: Calculates the capacity remaining when moving backwards from a specified date.

methods.name: endPreviousDay
methods.description: Finds the last available day before a given date in the calendar, considering exceptions.

methods.name: addBackward
methods.description: Moves backward in time from a start date by a specified duration, respecting calendar availability.

methods.name: getExceptionCapacityForDate
methods.description: Retrieves the exception capacity for a specific date, if any, from the calendar's exception days.
